purpose: Bounded full scanner analysis comparison of the compact GLRT-64 workspace against the current repository oracle

selection.rule: reuse the metadata-selected application_profile case at each of 2.5 and 5 Msps

gates: every full serialized response is exactly equal to the baseline warmup response
all frozen source and input metadata hashes match before and after execution
interpretation: Report complete conversion-plus-analysis CPU and wall time, not isolated workspace time.
This is a two-case development diagnostic and cannot qualify sensitivity or deployment.
No holdout, RF, production edit, ARM claim, or threshold tuning is allowed.
